svg.text: MetricMine Gold Layer — The Unified Event Star
Target-state placement in the contract-driven medallion · companion to Gold Layer Design 001 · July 11, 2026
Engine emits dbt models, never DDL (D-07) · star is terminal gold (D-17) · keys are content-derived v2 (D-18) · context binds by schema key (D-19)
MODELING PLANE — MAPPING CONTRACT IN, DBT MODELS OUT

g.text: writes only via PR · ownership manifest (D-09)
The star's physical schema is fixed. New sources
add rows, not schema. Payload evolution = new
New dimension in the mapping contract flows
through regeneration + dbt build: no engine code
change, no schema change, no contract bump —
announced by a new schema key.

svg.text: GOLD — the unified event star (terminal layer, D-17)
one DuckDB schema · working file gitignored · demo/gold.duckdb is the committed export (D-03)

g.text: JSON array manifest · a schema-key change
announces drift the moment it lands
run hash as non-key lineage attribute
measure payload JSON · grain per contract:
Meaning is one join away. Never embedded.
the 2023 deserialization ETL, now a view ·
C1 · silver rows = fact rows (or sum _row_count)
C3 · every schema key exists in the registry
C4 · every payload parses as valid JSON
writes one registry row per schema key

svg.text: SERVING — ONE SHARED QUERY MODULE, READ-ONLY (D-11)

g.text: lookup record by content key (provenance tool)

svg.text: Every arrow into gold is a pull request through the three gates. The engine never writes to main; the ownership manifest protects human-edited files (D-08, D-09).
Upstream (bronze, silver, profiler, agents) is unchanged by this design; what changed is that each step now knows exactly what it feeds.
Machine-readable companion: gold_unified_event_star_flow.mmd (Mermaid). Spec: Gold Layer Design 001, July 11, 2026.
